function_execute.name: Function Execute
function_execute.description: Execute JavaScript, Python, or shell scripts in a secure sandbox. For JS: fetch() is available, code runs in async IIFE wrapper. For shell: workspace env vars available as $VAR_NAME, pre-installed CLI tools (jq, curl, awscli, psql, gh, etc.). Use outputPath/outputTable to persist returned data, or outputSandboxPath + outputPath to export a file created inside the sandbox into the workspace.

code.description: Raw JavaScript statements (NOT a function). Code is auto-wrapped in async context. MUST use fetch() for HTTP (NOT xhr/axios/request libs). Write like: await fetch(url) then return result. NO import/require statements.

language.description: Language to execute (javascript, python, or shell)

outputPath.description: Write the tool result back to a workspace file, e.g. "files/result.json" or "files/report.csv". Use for text/JSON/CSV/markdown/html outputs.

outputFormat.description: Optional format override for outputPath (json, csv, txt, md, html).

outputTable.description: Overwrite a workspace table with the code result. The code must return an array of objects.

outputSandboxPath.description: Export a file created inside the sandbox to the workspace. Provide the sandbox file path here and also set outputPath to the workspace destination.

outputMimeType.description: MIME type for the exported file. Required for binary files (e.g. "image/png", "application/pdf"). If omitted, inferred from outputPath extension for text formats.

envVars.description: Environment variables to make available during execution

blockData.description: Block output data for variable resolution

blockNameMapping.description: Mapping of block names to block IDs

blockOutputSchemas.description: Mapping of block IDs to their output schemas for validation

channel.description: Channel ID where the message was posted (e.g., C1234567890)

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the message to delete (e.g., 1405894322.002768)

accessToken.description: OAuth access token or bot token for Slack API

fileId.description: The ID of the file to download

slack_edit_canvas.name: Slack Edit Canvas
slack_edit_canvas.description: Edit an existing Slack canvas by inserting, replacing, or deleting content

accessToken.description: OAuth access token or bot token for Slack API

operation.description: Edit operation: insert_at_start, insert_at_end, insert_after, insert_before, replace, delete, or rename

content.description: Markdown content for the operation (required for insert/replace operations)

sectionId.description: Section ID to target (required for insert_after, insert_before, replace, and delete)

title.description: New title for the canvas (only used with rename operation)

slack_ephemeral_message.name: Slack Ephemeral Message
slack_ephemeral_message.description: Send an ephemeral message visible only to a specific user in a channel. Optionally reply in a thread. The message does not persist across sessions.

accessToken.description: OAuth access token or bot token for Slack API

user.description: User ID who will see the ephemeral message (e.g., U1234567890). Must be a member of the channel.

text.description: Message text to send (supports Slack mrkdwn formatting)

threadTs.description: Thread timestamp to reply in. When provided, the ephemeral message appears as a thread reply.

blocks.description: Block Kit layout blocks as a JSON array. When provided, text becomes the fallback notification text.

slack_get_canvas.name: Slack Get Canvas Info
slack_get_canvas.description: Get Slack canvas file metadata by canvas ID

accessToken.description: OAuth access token or bot token for Slack API

canvasId.description: Canvas file ID to retrieve (e.g., F1234ABCD)

slack_get_channel_info.name: Slack Get Channel Info
slack_get_channel_info.description: Get detailed information about a Slack channel by its ID

accessToken.description: OAuth access token or bot token for Slack API

channel.description: Channel ID to get information about (e.g., C1234567890)

includeNumMembers.description: Whether to include the member count in the response

slack_get_message.name: Slack Get Message
slack_get_message.description: Retrieve a specific message by its timestamp. Useful for getting a thread parent message.

accessToken.description: OAuth access token or bot token for Slack API

slack_get_thread.name: Slack Get Thread
slack_get_thread.description: Retrieve an entire thread including the parent message and all replies. Useful for getting full conversation context.

accessToken.description: OAuth access token or bot token for Slack API

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default: 100, max: 200)

slack_get_user.name: Slack Get User Info
slack_get_user.description: Get detailed information about a specific Slack user by their user ID.

accessToken.description: OAuth access token or bot token for Slack API

userId.description: User ID to look up (e.g., U1234567890)

slack_get_user_presence.name: Slack Get User Presence
slack_get_user_presence.description: Check whether a Slack user is currently active or away

accessToken.description: OAuth access token or bot token for Slack API

userId.description: User ID to check presence for (e.g., U1234567890)

slack_invite_to_conversation.name: Slack Invite to Conversation
slack_invite_to_conversation.description: Invite one or more users to a Slack channel. Supports up to 100 users at a time.

accessToken.description: OAuth access token or bot token for Slack API

channel.description: The ID of the channel to invite users to

users.description: Comma-separated list of user IDs to invite (up to 100)

force.description: When true, continues inviting valid users while skipping invalid ones (default: false)

slack_list_canvases.name: Slack List Canvases
slack_list_canvases.description: List Slack canvases available to the authenticated user or bot

accessToken.description: OAuth access token or bot token for Slack API

channel.description: Filter canvases appearing in a specific channel ID

count.description: Number of canvases to return per page

user.description: Filter canvases created by a single user ID

tsFrom.description: Filter canvases created after this Unix timestamp

tsTo.description: Filter canvases created before this Unix timestamp

teamId.description: Encoded team ID, required when using an org-level token

slack_list_channels.name: Slack List Channels
slack_list_channels.description: List all channels in a Slack workspace. Returns public and private channels the bot has access to.

accessToken.description: OAuth access token or bot token for Slack API

includePrivate.description: Include private channels the bot is a member of (default: true)

limit.description: Maximum number of channels to return (default: 100, max: 200)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.next_cursor

slack_list_members.name: Slack List Channel Members
slack_list_members.description: List all members (user IDs) in a Slack channel. Use with Get User Info to resolve IDs to names.

accessToken.description: OAuth access token or bot token for Slack API

channel.description: Channel ID to list members from

limit.description: Maximum number of members to return (default: 100, max: 200)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.next_cursor

slack_list_users.name: Slack List Users
slack_list_users.description: List all users in a Slack workspace. Returns user profiles with names and avatars.

accessToken.description: OAuth access token or bot token for Slack API

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return (default: 100, max: 200)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.next_cursor

slack_lookup_canvas_sections.name: Slack Lookup Canvas Sections
slack_lookup_canvas_sections.description: Find Slack canvas section IDs matching criteria for later edits

accessToken.description: OAuth access token or bot token for Slack API

slack_message.name: Slack Message
slack_message.description: Send messages to Slack channels or direct messages. Supports Slack mrkdwn formatting.

accessToken.description: OAuth access token or bot token for Slack API

dmUserId.description: Slack user ID for direct messages (e.g., U1234567890)

text.description: Message text to send (supports Slack mrkdwn formatting)

threadTs.description: Thread timestamp to reply to (creates thread reply)

blocks.description: Block Kit layout blocks as a JSON array. When provided, text becomes the fallback notification text.

files.description: Files to attach to the message

slack_message_reader.name: Slack Message Reader
slack_message_reader.description: Read the latest messages from Slack channels. Retrieve conversation history with filtering options.

accessToken.description: OAuth access token or bot token for Slack API

channel.description: Slack channel ID to read messages from (e.g., C1234567890)

dmUserId.description: Slack user ID for DM conversation (e.g., U1234567890)

limit.description: Number of messages to retrieve (default: 10, max: 15)

slack_open_view.name: Slack Open View
slack_open_view.description: Open a modal view in Slack using a trigger_id from an interaction payload. Used to display forms, confirmations, and other interactive modals.

accessToken.description: OAuth access token or bot token for Slack API

triggerId.description: Exchange a trigger to post to the user. Obtained from an interaction payload (e.g., slash command, button click)

interactivityPointer.description: Alternative to trigger_id for posting to user

view.description: A view payload object defining the modal. Must include type ("modal"), title, and blocks array

slack_publish_view.name: Slack Publish View
slack_publish_view.description: Publish a static view to a user's Home tab in Slack. Used to create or update the app's Home tab experience.

accessToken.description: OAuth access token or bot token for Slack API

userId.description: The user ID to publish the Home tab view to (e.g., U0BPQUNTA)

hash.description: View state hash to protect against race conditions. Obtained from a previous views response

view.description: A view payload object defining the Home tab. Must include type ("home") and blocks array

slack_push_view.name: Slack Push View
slack_push_view.description: Push a new view onto an existing modal stack in Slack. Limited to 2 additional views after the initial modal is opened.

accessToken.description: OAuth access token or bot token for Slack API

triggerId.description: Exchange a trigger to post to the user. Obtained from an interaction payload (e.g., button click within an existing modal)

interactivityPointer.description: Alternative to trigger_id for posting to user

view.description: A view payload object defining the modal to push. Must include type ("modal"), title, and blocks array

slack_remove_reaction.name: Slack Remove Reaction
slack_remove_reaction.description: Remove an emoji reaction from a Slack message

accessToken.description: OAuth access token or bot token for Slack API

channel.description: Channel ID where the message was posted (e.g., C1234567890)

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the message to remove reaction from (e.g., 1405894322.002768)

name.description: Name of the emoji reaction to remove (without colons, e.g., thumbsup, heart, eyes)

slack_update_message.name: Slack Update Message
slack_update_message.description: Update a message previously sent by the bot in Slack

accessToken.description: OAuth access token or bot token for Slack API

channel.description: Channel ID where the message was posted (e.g., C1234567890)

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the message to update (e.g., 1405894322.002768)

text.description: New message text (supports Slack mrkdwn formatting)

blocks.description: Block Kit layout blocks as a JSON array. When provided, text becomes the fallback notification text.

slack_update_view.name: Slack Update View
slack_update_view.description: Update an existing modal view in Slack. Identify the view by view_id or external_id, and provide the updated view payload.

accessToken.description: OAuth access token or bot token for Slack API

viewId.description: Unique identifier of the view to update. Either viewId or externalId is required

externalId.description: Developer-set unique identifier of the view to update (max 255 chars). Either viewId or externalId is required

hash.description: View state hash to protect against race conditions. Obtained from a previous views response

view.description: A view payload object defining the updated modal. Must include type ("modal"), title, and blocks array. Use identical block_id and action_id values to preserve input data

table_batch_insert_rows.name: Batch Insert Rows
table_batch_insert_rows.description: Insert multiple rows into a table at once (up to 1000 rows)

rows.description: Array of row data objects (max 1000 rows)

table_create.name: Create Table
table_create.description: Create a new user-defined table with schema

table_delete_row.name: Delete Row
table_delete_row.description: Delete a row from a table

table_delete_rows_by_filter.name: Delete Rows by Filter
table_delete_rows_by_filter.description: Delete multiple rows that match filter criteria. Use with caution - supports optional limit for safety.

filter.description: Filter criteria using operators like $eq, $ne, $gt, $lt, $contains, $in, etc.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to delete (default: no limit, max: 1000)

table_get_row.name: Get Row
table_get_row.description: Get a single row by ID

table_get_schema.name: Get Schema
table_get_schema.description: Get the schema configuration of a table

table_insert_row.name: Insert Row
table_insert_row.description: Insert a new row into a table. IMPORTANT: You must use the "data" parameter (not "values", "row", "fields", or other variations) to specify the row contents.

table_list.name: List Tables
table_list.description: List all tables in the canvas

table_query_rows.name: Query Rows
table_query_rows.description: Query rows from a table with filtering, sorting, and pagination

table_update_row.name: Update Row
table_update_row.description: Update an existing row in a table. Supports partial updates - only include the fields you want to change. IMPORTANT: You must use the "data" parameter (not "values", "row", "fields", or other variations) to specify the fields to update.

table_update_rows_by_filter.name: Update Rows by Filter
table_update_rows_by_filter.description: Update multiple rows that match filter criteria. Data is merged with existing row data.

filter.description: Filter criteria using operators like $eq, $ne, $gt, $lt, $contains, $in, etc.

data.description: Fields to update (merged with existing data)

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to update (default: no limit, max: 1000)

table_upsert_row.name: Upsert Row
table_upsert_row.description: Insert or update a row based on unique column constraints. If a row with matching unique field exists, update it; otherwise insert a new row. IMPORTANT: You must use the "data" parameter (not "values", "row", "fields", or other variations) to specify the row contents.

data.description: Row data to insert or update

webhook_request.name: Webhook Request
webhook_request.description: Send a webhook request with automatic headers and optional HMAC signing

url.description: The webhook URL to send the request to

workflow_executor.name: Workflow Executor
workflow_executor.description: Execute another workflow as a sub-workflow. Pass inputs as a JSON object with field names matching the child workflow's input format. Example: if child expects "name" and "email", pass {"name": "John", "email": "john@example.com"}

workflowId.description: The ID of the workflow to execute

inputMapping.description: JSON object with keys matching the child workflow's input field names. Each key should map to the value you want to pass for that input field. Example: {"fieldName": "value", "otherField": 123}
